create_OutputProcessor: create an OutputProcessor instance to process EngineCoreOutputs into RequestOutputs with configurable stream interval and tracing
process_outputs_engine_core: process a list of EngineCoreOutputs into RequestOutputs, detokenize tokens, compute logprobs, and handle streaming intervals
abort_requests_output_processor: abort a list of requests by external or internal request ID, producing final abort outputs and cleaning up request states
add_request_output_processor: add a new request to the OutputProcessor by creating a RequestState with detokenizer, logprobs processor, and streaming input support
collect_streamed_request_outputs: collect streamed RequestOutputs per request using RequestOutputCollector with async put and get operations for hand-off to generate tasks
